pattern: choose a card exiled this way

examples.text: Exile the top four cards of your library, then choose a card exiled this way. You may play that card this turn.
Whenever ~ attacks, exile the top two cards of your library. Choose a card exiled this way. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.

counterExamples: Exile the top four cards of your library, then choose a card exiled this way.
Exile the top four cards of your library, then choose a card milled this way. You may play that card this turn.
Exile the top four cards of your library, then choose two cards exiled this way. You may play that card this turn.

subject: player

examples.text: Target opponent reveals X cards from their hand, where X is the number of artifacts you control. You choose one of those cards. That player exiles it.
When ~ enters, target opponent reveals X cards from their hand, where X is the number of Elves you control. You choose one of those cards. That player exiles that card.

counterExamples: Target opponent reveals X cards from their hand, where X is the number of artifacts you control. You choose one of those cards. That player discards it.
Target opponent reveals X cards from their hand, where X is the number of artifacts you control. You choose one of those cards. That player exiles it face down.
Target opponent reveals X cards from their hand, where X is the number of artifacts you control. You choose two of those cards. That player exiles them.
